toss your note to the bin

Motionby @proskuaaa2026-08-18inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Toss your note to the bin: a playful way to delete a note - the sticky note ('Check the produce section for any discounts...' with a heart-arrow scribble, color pickers below) crumples into a paper ball when you pull down; the screen turns into a wire-mesh trash can with 'Pull down to aim your toss'; release flings the ball along an arc into the bin with a satisfying dunk; then cuts back to the notes grid ('Sunday Brunch Prep').

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Note editor: pink sticky with text + scribble, color swatch row, tag chips, copy/share/draw/trash actions.
20-40%
Note crumples: the flat sticky morphs into a crumpled yellow paper ball (crinkle texture) as user pulls down; scene swaps to a sketched wire trash can on a white field.
40-70%
Aiming: ball hangs near the bottom, bin above; 'Pull down to aim your toss ↓' hint; ball sways with the drag.
70-90%
Release: ball arcs up along a parabola and drops into the mesh bin (slight rim bounce, bin jiggle).
90-100%
Cut back to the notes list/grid (grocery cards: Fentimans Rose Lemonade, BellGioso Parmesan...) - note gone.

Mechanics

trigger
pull-down gesture + release
elements
sticky note, crumple morph, paper ball, wire bin, aim hint
properties
crumple progress (scale/skew/noise), drag y -> aim angle/power, release arc (gravity sim), bin jiggle
timing
crumple 400ms tied to drag; toss ~700ms ballistic
easing
ballistic gravity; bin wobble spring
loop
no

Build prompt

Build a toss-to-delete gesture. Note editor screen (iPhone): colored sticky note card (pink/yellow, 16px radius, scribble doodle), swatch row, chips, bottom action bar. On pull-down past 60px: crossfade to a white scene with a sketched wire-mesh trash can (grey line-art, slight 3D tilt) upper-center; the note visually crumples - animate border-radius to 50%, scale to 0.45, apply a crinkle texture overlay + random 2deg rotations keyed to drag distance (400ms of drag travel). Hint 'Pull down to aim your toss ↓' 12px grey. While dragging, the ball sticks to the finger with a rubber-band (0.85 factor); release computes velocity -> launch the ball on a 2D projectile arc (gravity 2400px/s^2) toward the bin mouth; on entry, ball scales into the bin (clip), bin wobbles (rotate +-4deg spring 600ms) with a puff; then hard-cut back to the notes grid where the card is gone. Haptic: medium on crumple, heavy on dunk.
